text: Choose a buddy for a friendship adventure. We can say hello, share, and play together!
Let's look at whose turn it is. Try the glowing spot.
Let's look again. Find the same picture as your friend.
We did it together! You can play again or choose all done.
A new friend is here. How would you like to say hello?
You said hello! A wave or a smile can help start a friendship.
Give a little wave
A little wave says hello. Let us practice a friendly greeting.
Give a friendly smile
A smile can say hello, too. Let us practice a friendly greeting.
Tap to send three friendly greetings.
Your friend would like to watch for now. What could you do?
You gave your friend space. Friends can choose to watch or play.
Wave from here
A wave from here gives your friend space to watch.
Smile and give space
A smile gives your friend a welcome without asking them to join.
Send three gentle greetings from your side. Your friend can watch.
There are shared blocks for both of you. How could you start?
You shared the blocks and built together. Each friend had a turn!
Ask to build together
Your friend says yes. Let us take turns adding blocks.
Offer the first block
Your friend accepts a block. Let us build together.
Drag each block to the glowing building spot. Your turn!
Drag each block to the glowing building spot. Your friend's turn!
Your friend wants to help build a bridge. What could you say?
Two builders made a bridge together. Sharing ideas helps us play!
Let us take turns
Your friend agrees. A turn for each builder!
We can share these blocks
Your friend is ready to share the building blocks.
You would like to play ball with your friend. How could you ask?
You rolled, waited, and got a turn again. That is taking turns!
Want to roll the ball?
Your friend says yes to a gentle rolling game.
Shall we play together?
Your friend wants to play. Let us share the ball.
Tap the ball to roll it back and forth. Your turn!
Tap the ball to roll it back and forth. Your friend's turn!
You both want a turn with a toy car. What is a friendly plan?
The car went to both friends. Waiting made room for another turn.
A turn for each of us
Your friend agrees to take turns driving the toy car.
Let us pass it back and forth
Your friend likes that plan. Let us share the toy car.
Tap the car to send it along your shared road. Your turn!
Tap the car to send it along your shared road. Your friend's turn!
Your friend wants a silly face game. How could you join?
You copied silly faces together. Friends can share a giggle!
Let us copy each other
Your friend makes a face. Let us find the matching silly face.
Show me a silly face
Your friend has a silly face to show. Let us copy it.
Find the picture that matches your friend. Tap smile.
Find the picture that matches your friend. Tap wink.
Find the picture that matches your friend. Tap surprise.
Your friend wants to pretend to be animals. What could you say?
You tried a pretend game together. Watching and tiny movements count, too.
Let us pretend together
Your friend chooses an animal. Find the matching animal picture.
You choose, then I will try
Your friend chooses first. You can copy the picture or pretend along.
Find the picture that matches your friend. Tap bunny.
Find the picture that matches your friend. Tap bird.
Find the picture that matches your friend. Tap fish.
You both want to pop bubbles. What would help you share?
You left bubbles for each other. Sharing kept the fun going!
One for me, one for you
Your friend likes taking turns with the bubbles.
Let us leave some for each other
You leave bubbles for your friend. Let us take turns.
Pop a teal bubble for you, then a purple bubble for your friend. Your turn!
Pop a teal bubble for you, then a purple bubble for your friend. Your friend's turn!
There are sparkly stars for both friends. How could you share?
Both friends got sparkles. A fair turn can feel good!
We can take turns
Your friend agrees to take turns choosing stars.
Some for you and some for me
There are stars for both of you. Let us take turns.
Tap a teal star for you, then a purple star for your friend. Your turn!
Tap a teal star for you, then a purple star for your friend. Your friend's turn!
Your friend has toys to put away. How could you help?
You helped tidy the shared space. Helping is a way to care for a friend.
Can I help tidy up?
Your friend says yes. Let us put the toys in the box together.
Let us each put some away
Your friend likes sharing the tidy-up job.
Drag each toy into the toy box.
Your friend is making a picture. How could you join?
You made a picture together. Different ideas can belong side by side.
May I add a heart?
Your friend says yes. Add hearts to your shared picture.
Let us decorate together
Your friend wants to decorate together. Add hearts to the picture.
Drag each heart onto the friendship picture.
